title: ControllerProfile
description: A controller family of the raw device layer (ADR-0014, spec section 2.4.2), profile data in the style of ADR-0012: the logs a bioreactor controller writes (tag log, alarm log, batch-phase log) and the logging deadbands of its tags. Every numeric parameter is {value, unit, ref} with ref a ledger id; modeled_on lists S### ids that must resolve; the banner line is required. A synthetic format modeled on public documentation, not a real controller file. The emitter and adapter for it are built in S2e2 (Step 7); this schema fixes the data.

banner.const: synthetic, modeled on public documentation; not a real instrument file

form.description: ctrl_neutral writes the unit in its own column, ctrl_bench in parentheses inside the variable name (A171); the adapter rewrites both to unit_tag.signal.role.
